name: Sunrise Pipeline
researcher_notes: Not part of the Equitrans Mainline row P6895. That row and P6896 and P6897 have no endpoints or length, and the Sunrise project is its own FERC docket (CP11-68), a new pipe from Wetzel County, West Virginia to Greene County, Pennsylvania. A Federal Register notice from May 2011 (FERC environmental assessment) states about 44.4 miles of new 16-inch to 24-inch pipeline, plus 2.6 miles of replacement pipe, in those two counties. The August 2026 EIA project table (sheet Historical Projects 1996-2024, Excel row 720, project name Sunrise Project) lists it as Completed, in service 2012, 50 miles, 16, 20 and 24 inch, 313.56 MMcf/d additional capacity, cost 272 million dollars. EIA says 50 miles and the notice says 44.4 miles of new pipe; staged the 44.4 miles from the notice. Capacity is the incremental figure. Both loaded and name the project; the two are different publishers (FERC notice and EIA). The EIA ref is cited by its dated file. Owner uses the gazetteer spelling Equitrans LP; the parent at the time was Equitrans Midstream Corp, not staged. Start year 2012 comes from EIA. Route not researched; marked no route pending a route pass. Diameter 20 inch appears only in EIA.
